name: gantt

frames.best_why: Every group, bar and marker is visible across the timeline with no cursor covering a label.

tagline: A roadmap timeline with grouped tasks, coloured bars and a today line.
summary: A project Gantt chart with a grouped task sidebar and a month timeline. Feature bars are coloured by status and can be dragged or resized, with milestone markers and a today line.
appearance: A wide dark chart split into a left list of grouped task rows and a month grid. Short rounded bars in grey, amber and green sit on the rows, with year and month labels across the top and marker tags above them.
behaviour: Dragging a bar moves it horizontally along the timeline and its edge handles resize it; hovering an empty column offers an add button. Clicking a sidebar row scrolls the timeline to that feature, and the today line marks the current date.
demo_content: Groups Research, Design, Engineering, Launch; tasks like Customer interviews and Billing API v2; two markers.
use_when: A product roadmap or project plan needs draggable bars across months with grouped tasks.
avoid_when: You only need a simple list of dates; this ships a large Gantt with drag and extending scroll.
customise: Give the provider a range and zoom, then pass grouped features and markers; statuses carry their own colours. Row height, column width and sidebar width are provider props.
weight_why: Many positioned bars with drag listeners across a scrollable grid, but no per-frame loop.

a11y.note: Sidebar rows work from the keyboard, but moving and resizing bars needs a pointer; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: Text in the sidebar and bars is very small, which hurts legibility.
Moving and resizing bars is pointer-only, so keyboard users cannot reschedule.
polish_why: Dense but orderly roadmap with colour-coded bars; small text and pointer-only dragging.
